name: gg-company-accounts-and-reporting
description: Guernsey company accounting and reporting reference for ordinary local trading companies limited by shares. Covers transaction records, retention, annual accounts, financial periods, member circulation, audit-waiver timing and the separate annual validation. Includes December-incorporation and advance-waiver examples, a document workflow and explicit gaps for audit-excluded companies and specialised entities. Prepared for 2026 from Guernsey Registry primary guidance, including the current annual-validation page and directors handbook. Current consolidated accounts, validation and audit-waiver provisions and the audit-exclusion regulations were recovered and checked on 27 October 2026. Specialised entities and the detailed civil-penalty boundary rules remain outside the established ordinary methods; this draft requires professional review before reliance.
